# laravelforge_server_background_process (Resource)

Manages a background process (long-running daemon-like process) on a Laravel Forge server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) The command to run. Create-only.
- `name` (String) The name of the background process.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `processes` (Number) The number of processes to run.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the background process runs on.
- `user` (String) The user to run the background process as (`root` or `forge`). Create-only.

### Optional

- `config` (String) The supervisor configuration of the background process. Update-only (write-only; not returned by the API).
- `directory` (String) The directory to run the background process from. Create-only.
- `site_id` (Number) The site to associate the background process with. Create-only.
- `startsecs` (Number) The number of seconds to wait before starting the process. Create-only.
- `stopsignal` (String) The signal to send to stop the process (e.g. `SIGTERM`). Create-only.
- `stopwaitsecs` (Number) The number of seconds to wait before stopping the process. Create-only.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the background process.
- `status` (String) The status of the background process.
- `type` (String) JSON:API resource type.
